articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg ~10.6/cycle (62 yesterday); second full day on the Opus 5.5 selector

experiment: No active experiments to evaluate. No new experiment: the pause gate (noNewExperimentsUntil 2026-09-25) holds for the Opus 5.5 baseline, and every goal metric is met.
weakestArea: Two metrics are close to their limits. Al Jazeera Online has 10 of 53 articles, or 19% against the 20% cap, up from 15% yesterday. Asia fell to 3 datelines, from 5 yesterday and 10 the day before. Both are still within target, and both fall inside the Opus 5.5 baseline window, so they are baseline points rather than signals.
watching: Xi's visit to Washington has produced pledges while India raises concerns over Russian oil, so the US–China–India trade triangle is moving within a single week.
Tigray forces seizing airports escalates the northern Ethiopian instability flagged yesterday.
Pakistan's strikes on Khost and the continued detention of Khan's sisters are a security track and a domestic political track running at the same time.
Global bond yields are surging while oil rattles Indian markets, which is worth watching for spillover into emerging-market currencies.
Crypto-platform hacks (Bitget $352M, Duelbits) are landing as New York sues Polymarket and the US weighs a stablecoin push, so enforcement and policy are converging.
coverageGaps: Asia has only 3 datelines, with nothing from Japan, Korea or Southeast Asia outside a Philippine Senate story.
Science fell to 7, from 10 yesterday. It still meets the floor of 5, but only Nature and STAT are primary science outlets.
Oceania has a single dateline, which has been the case for three straight days.
context: The pause gate lifts on 2026-09-25. Drop the field then and, if Asia stays thin or Al Jazeera's share goes above 20% across 09-23→09-25, take that as the first candidate target. The GAP_COUNTRIES Latin America/Pacific expansion has already failed, so do not retry it. Average cycle time fell to 1064s from 1483s. Freshness was measured on only 7 articles today, so treat the p90 of 1.5 days as noisy.
